facts.text: The hotel is in Cherry Creek, one of Denver's most walkable neighborhoods.
facts.excerpt: staying in one of Denver's most renowned and walkable neighborhoods, Cherry Creek

facts.text: Stepping outside the hotel puts guests in Cherry Creek North, an outdoor retail and dining destination with a collection of art galleries.
facts.excerpt: Step outside our doors and find yourself in Denver's premier outdoor retail and dining destination with an impressive collection of art galleries.

facts.text: Select guest rooms have unobstructed views of the Rocky Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy unobstructed views of the Rocky Mountains in select guest rooms at our Cherry Creek hotel.

facts.text: Rooms have five-piece marble bathrooms with signature Clio bathrobes.
facts.excerpt: Feel refreshed in an elegant five-piece marble bathrooms complete with signature Clio bathrobes.

facts.text: Room amenities include a Lavazza espresso machine and complimentary bottled water.
facts.excerpt: Amenities include a Lavazza espresso machine, complimentary bottled water, and elevated room service

facts.text: Butler pantries on each floor provide still and sparkling water on tap.
facts.excerpt: Buttlery pantries on each floor provide still and sparkling water on tap.

facts.text: The one-bedroom suites have a king bed, a spacious living area, a powder room and an oversized soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: the one-bedroom suites at our luxury Cherry Creek hotel features a king bed and spacious living area, modern powder room and an over-sized soaking tub.

facts.text: Rooms are spacious, with writing desks, a seating area and more than 400 square feet.
facts.excerpt: Spacious rooms feel like mini-houses, with writing desks, a seating area, and more than 400 square feet.

facts.text: The hotel says its accommodations are the largest in Cherry Creek.
facts.excerpt: our newly refreshed accommodations are the largest in Denver's Cherry Creek

facts.text: Toro Latin Kitchen & Lounge follows Central and South American convivial dining, with a ceviche bar, small plates and family-style entrees.
facts.excerpt: In the tradition of Central and South American convivial dining culture, Toro Denver features a ceviche bar, small plates, and family-style entrees, plus, hand-muddled cocktails, local beer and wine.

facts.text: Toro offers a ceviche making class with Executive Chef Oscar Padilla every Friday.
facts.excerpt: Learn to create your own ceviche with Toro's Ceviche Making Class with Executive Chef Oscar Padilla every Friday at 4 p.m.

facts.text: Twice a week the concierge team leads guests on a guided walking tour of Cherry Creek.
facts.excerpt: Twice a week our knowledgeable concierge team takes guests on a guided exploration of our beloved Cherry Creek neighborhood.

facts.text: The 24-hour fitness center features Peloton bikes and Hydro rowers.
facts.excerpt: Peloton Bikes and Hydro Rowers featured

facts.text: Through partnerships, guests can do vertical climbing at Studio CLMBR, interval training at Barry's Bootcamp and workouts at SoulCycle.
facts.excerpt: such as stimulating vertical climbing at Studio CLMBR, high-intensity interval training at Barry's Bootcamp and immersive, full-body workouts at SoulCycle.

facts.text: The Denver Botanic Gardens, a 23-acre park, is within walking distance of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Walking distance from Hotel Clio, the Denver Botanic Gardens is a 23-acre park located in the heart of the city.

facts.text: The Cherry Creek Trail passes through the heart of the Cherry Creek neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: The sunken Cherry Creek Trail passes through the heart of the Cherry Creek neighborhood

facts.text: Event venues include modern ballrooms, a secluded indoor/outdoor event space and an intimate rooftop deck.
facts.excerpt: Home to spacious modern ballrooms, a secluded indoor/outdoor event space and an intimate rooftop deck

facts.text: Complimentary cribs are available on request, and families can ask for a king room with a queen-sized sofa sleeper.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary cribs are available upon request, or you can ask for a king room with a queen-sized sofa sleeper for the kiddos.

facts.text: The hotel was formerly the JW Marriott.
facts.excerpt: A family-friendly standby in the bustling shopping district of Cherry Creek North and formerly the JW Marriott

facts.text: Dogs are allowed for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are allowed at Hotel Clio for an additional fee.

facts.text: Parking is valet only, with no self-parking at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking only. No self-parking at hotel.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Hotel Clio, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Denver Cherry Creek do not have a fridge.

facts.excerpt: Green Key Eco-Rating Program Certified
